scope: Fresh offline companion reference-fixture evidence only; excludes the ongoing native live matrix and historical packaged evidence.

checks: Compared unique JSON test IDs and statuses with JUnit testcase IDs and failure/error/skip nodes.
Recounted matrix cell reports and their individual checks.
Compared mutation summary claims with each retained mutation report and event evidence.
Recomputed recorded source, report, evidence, log and workspace snapshot SHA-256 hashes.
Inspected runtime events, operation IDs, policy denials, tool service audits, read exposure, publication recovery/rollback and session lineage.

subtests.limitation: Successful subtests are retained as an aggregate count, not individual execution records; the reported count agrees with source loop enumeration.

mutations.interpretation: All six selected defects were detected; this is not a general mutation coverage score.

hash_verification.note: Hash categories overlap where retained files are referenced by more than one layer of evidence.

changes: Rebased the starter source reference to the public companion's relative location. Raw companion evidence is copied unchanged.
projection.hash_interpretation: The original input SHA-256 identifies the unmodified source. It is not a checksum of this derivative; exported-file checksums are recorded separately.
